prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1352; do not mention it.)
text: On arrival at the scene in Baytown, Texas, the responding officer found two vehicles stopped in the right lane of a four-lane roadway with visible contact damage to the left rear quarter panel of Vehicle 1 and the right front fender of Vehicle 2. Driver 1 stated that they were attempting a lane change to the left when Vehicle 2, traveling in the adjacent lane, moved into the same space and made contact along the side of the vehicle. Driver 2 stated that they checked their mirror, saw no vehicle in the lane, and began to merge when the impact occurred. Driver 1 reported pain in the lower back and neck and stated they had been briefly unable to exit the vehicle without assistance. A Passenger seated in the rear of Vehicle 1 reported no injury. Both drivers remained on scene, exchanged insurance information, and were cooperative. Weather was clear and the road surface was dry. Driver 1 was transported by EMS for evaluation. No citations were issued at the time of the report pending further review.
